description: This Java class defines a configuration object 'DefaultConnectionPoolConfig' used for setting up MongoDB connection pool parameters such as max size, wait queue size, wait time, and JMX listener enablement. It implements the 'MongoDbConfig.ConnectionPoolConfig' interface and provides static factory method 'of' to create instances based on external configuration.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionPoolConfig
classes.description: Immutable configuration class for MongoDB connection pool settings, implementing ConnectionPoolConfig.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultConnectionPoolConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the connection pool.

methods.name: getMaxWaitQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum wait queue size for connection requests.

methods.name: getMaxWaitTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum wait time for a connection.

methods.name: isJmxListenerEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether JMX listener is enabled for this connection pool.
